say:4:1620217003:1.text: Magister Merlin, I've come to bid you farewell. With my duties here concluded, it's time for me to return to Savannah and report to the Queen.
say:4:1620217003:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，我是来向你告辞的。我在这里的公务已经暂告一段...

say:5:1620217004:1.text: I'll be escorting Gervan back, where he'll face further interrogation.
say:5:1620217004:1.source_cn: 这次我会将格墨文一起押送至王都，他会在那里接受进一步的审讯。

say:6:1620217005:1.text: Gervan... How is he doing now?
say:6:1620217005:1.source_cn: 格墨文……他，他现在怎么样？

say:7:1620217006:1.text: Physically, he's fine, but mentally... not really. It's understandable that he's upset.
say:7:1620217006:1.source_cn: 他目前的身体状况尚好，精神状态嘛……我相信你们也清楚，...

say:8:1620217007:1.text: Envoy Evie, could I... see him?
say:8:1620217007:1.source_cn: 伊芙特使，我……我能见见他吗？

say:9:1620217008:1.text: No matter what, he was once my best friend. I'd like to speak with him one last time... before he's sent to the royal capital.
say:9:1620217008:1.source_cn: 无论他现在如何，他都曾是我最好的朋友。对于他，我的心情...

say:10:1620217009:1.text: Hmm... This goes against the rules, but considering your efforts to bring him to justice, I'm willing to make an exception—
say:10:1620217009:1.source_cn: 嗯……说实话，这是违反规定的。不过看在你在这次事件中的...

say:12:1620217011:1.text: Wait, I'm not finished. I can arrange a meeting, but it'll be under my supervision. And you are not to touch him or exchange anything with him. Can you agree to that?
say:12:1620217011:1.source_cn: 等等，我话还没说完。我可以给你破例，但必须在我的监管之...

say:13:1620217012:1.text: Understood, Envoy Evie. I'll do as you say.
say:13:1620217012:1.source_cn: 我知道了，伊芙特使。放心，我会遵守这些规定的。

say:14:1620217013:1.text: Come with me, then. My team's already waiting at the <style="highlight">Lyceum docks</style>.
say:14:1620217013:1.source_cn: 那就跟我来吧，我的队伍已经在<style=highli...

say:16:1620217002:1.text: Is it that obvious? With the turmoil at the Lyceum finally settled, a great weight has lifted from my shoulders.
say:16:1620217002:1.source_cn: 也可以这么说……毕竟莱希拉姆的事情解决了，我也算放下了...
